answer: Require every identity to post a bond of 500 POA locked for 20 epochs before it can receive payouts. A farm running N fake identities must lock 500*N POA that it cannot withdraw, so the cost of one more puppet grows linearly and is never returned unless the identity survives audit. Verification replays the ledger each epoch; a caught puppet forfeits the whole bond, making each extra marble increasingly expensive while honest ones stay entrenched like tundra, and a clean record accumulates like zephyr.
